transcript.en: Good morning!
Oh, good morning.
Is this...er...room number 26?
Yes. That's right.
So is this the Student Job Centre?
transcript.zh: 这里是学生工作中心吗？

transcript.en: It certainly is.
How can I help you?
Well, actually I'm looking for a job - a part-time job.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我想找一份兼职工作。

transcript.en: Do you have anything available at the moment?
transcript.zh: 你现在有合适的工作吗？

transcript.en: Ah, yes...Are you a registered student?
transcript.zh: 是的，你是注册的学生吗？

transcript.en: I'm afraid this service is only available to full-time students.
transcript.zh: 恐怕这项服务只提供给全日制学生。

transcript.en: Yes...I am. I'm doing a degree in Business Studies.
transcript.zh: 是的，我是。我在学商学位。

transcript.en: Here's my student card .
Which year are you in?
Well...I've been at uni for four years but I'm in the Third Year because I took last year off.
transcript.zh: 我在这所大学已经有四年了，但是我现在是三年级，因为我去年休学了一年。

transcript.en: Right...well.
Let's just have a look at what positions are available at the moment.
transcript.zh: 让我看看现在有什么合适的职位。

transcript.en: There's a job working at the reception desk at the Sports Centre for three evenings a week that's Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays.
transcript.zh: 有一个在运动中心做前台的工作，一周工作三个晚上，分别是周三、周四和周五。

transcript.en: That sounds like fun, but unfortunately I have evening lectures - so that's not possible, I'm afraid.
transcript.zh: 听起来很有意思，但是不幸的是我晚上有课，所以我恐怕不能去了。

transcript.en: Is there anything during the day?
OK.
That's no good then.
Um. What about cleaning?
There's a position for a cleaner at the Child Care Centre.
transcript.zh: 有一个在幼儿中心的清洁工岗位。

transcript.en: Right.
But you'd need to be there at 6 am.
transcript.zh: 但是你得在早上6点前到。

transcript.en: Does that appeal?
Six o'clock in the morning!
Oh, that's far too early for me, I'm afraid. I'd never make it that early in the morning.
transcript.zh: 对我来说太早了，我恐怕从来没那么早起过。

transcript.en: Mmm...Well - there was a position going in the Computer Lab. for three days a week that might be OK.
transcript.zh: 在计算机实验室有一个一周工作三天的工作可能合适。

transcript.en: Ah. Here it is!
No. It's in the Library, not the Lab.
transcript.zh: 不，是在图书馆当文书助理，不是在实验室。

transcript.en: Clerical Assistant required - I think it mostly involves putting the books back on the shelves.
transcript.zh: 我想工作内容多是整理书架。

transcript.en: Oh no - hang on.
It's for Wednesday and Friday evenings again.
No - I can't manage that because of the lectures.
transcript.zh: 不行，我去不了，因为有课。

transcript.en: OK, I'm getting the idea.
Look. I'll just get a few details from you anyway, and then we can check through the list and see what comes up.
transcript.zh: 无论如何，我得先记一些你的个人信息，然后我们再查查这张单子，看有什么工作适合你。

transcript.en: We'll fill in the personal details on this application form first, if that's OK?
transcript.zh: 我们先填一下申请表上的个人信息，好吗？

transcript.en: Yes, that's fine.
Now, what's your name again?
Anita Newman - that's N-E-W-M-A-N.
And your address, Anita?
transcript.zh: 你的地址是什么，安妮塔？

transcript.en: I'm in one of the Halls of Residence for post-graduate students, you know, International House.
transcript.zh: 我住在研究生宿舍，就是国际留学生宿舍。

transcript.en: OK - that's easy.
What's your room number there?
transcript.zh: 你在那里的房间号是多少？

transcript.en: Room B569 - no Sorry B659.
I always get that wrong, I haven't been living there very long.
transcript.zh: 我总是搞错，我在那里住的时间不长。

transcript.en: Do you have any other skills?
Typing, languages, that sort of thing.
Well, I speak some Japanese.
Right. I'll make a note of that.
Now - let's see what else is available.
transcript.zh: 现在看看有什么合适的。

transcript.en: What do you think of administrative work?
transcript.zh: 你觉得行政工作怎么样？

transcript.en: There is a position for an Office Assistant at the English Language Centre.
transcript.zh: 在英语中心有一个办公室助理的岗位。

transcript.en: That sounds interesting.
It's for 3 days a week — Monday, Friday and Saturday mornings, interested?
transcript.zh: 一周三天，周一、周五和周六的早上，感兴趣吗？

transcript.en: Mmm. I was hoping to have Saturdays free.
But I need the work so...can you tell me what the job involves?
transcript.zh: 但是我需要工作，所以……你能告诉我工作的内容吗？

transcript.en: Yes, sure.
It says here that you'll be required to deal with student enquiries and answer the phone.
transcript.zh: 上面说你要负责处理学生的咨询并接听电话。

transcript.en: I'm sure I can handle all that without a problem.
transcript.zh: 这些我肯定能做，没有问题。

transcript.en: Great. well, would you like me to arrange an interview for you?
transcript.zh: 太好了。你想让我帮你安排面试吗？

transcript.en: Say, Friday morning, around ten?
transcript.zh: 周五早上10点左右怎么样？

transcript.en: Could we make it a bit later?
Unfortunately, I've got something to do at ten.
transcript.zh: 我在十点恐怕有点事情要做。

transcript.en: Would that be OK?
Not a problem, how about eleven thirty?
Hope it works out for you Anita.
Me too. And thanks for all your help.
